title: LoRA Trainer
hero_prompt: Cut-paper silhouette art in the eighteenth-century profile tradition, flat black paper shapes on warm cream paper, hand-cut edges, flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: the same woman's black profile silhouette repeated five times in a row across the banner, identical every time, each set against a different small cut-paper backdrop: a leafy tree, a tall window, a breaking wave, a crescent moon, a rolling hill. One likeness holding true in every new scene.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast emblem of a single stylized profile face-mark — thick black silhouette with one sharp jaw and brow line — reading clearly as a small mark with no fine crosshatching.
